notes: CoTracker-3 Online step graph (scaled_online.pth). Static T=16, step=8. The point axis N is dynamic: feed however many queries the sequence has. Trace N was 4. Always 384x512 model_resolution (eval scale is not applied; native frames → this size).
Outputs: tracks (pixels) plus new_* state. Copy new_* → previous_* on the next window.
First call: pass zeros for all previous_*. Later calls: feed back new_*.
new_coords are stride-space; new_visibility/new_confidence are pre-sigmoid logits.
Queries (t,x,y) use t as an index into the current window (STIR: t=0). Points queried after the first window are not remapped by online_ind.
The graph rewrites 5D GridSample as 4D grid_sample + temporal lerp. The point axis stays dynamic.
